Only H10.811 is reported, for pingueculitis of the right eye, which is the inflamed pinguecula.

- **Pinguecula is not coded separately.** Under H10.81 (pingueculitis), there is an Excludes1 note for pinguecula (H11.15-), and H11.15- carries the reverse Excludes1 for pingueculitis. That means the two codes cannot be reported together. Pingueculitis already captures the underlying pinguecula with inflammation, so H11.151 is left off.
- **No external cause code applies.** The note documents no injury or external cause.

I recalled these codes and their Excludes1 notes from memory, not from the FY2027 tabular itself. Before reporting, confirm in the FY2027 release that no new pingueculitis or pinguecula codes were added.

["H10.811"]

```json
["D66", "M36.2"]
```

- **D66 (Hereditary factor VIII deficiency)** is listed first. The Tabular note at M36.2 says to code first the underlying disease, such as factor VIII deficiency (D66).
- **M36.2 (Hemophilic arthropathy)** covers the right knee arthropathy that the provider attributes to the hemophilia. M36.2 has no laterality subcodes in the code set I know. I couldn't confirm the FY2027 tabular, so check for any new laterality expansion.
- **No acute hemarthrosis code** is added because the exam documents no effusion or bleeding into the joint today.
- **No external cause codes** apply because the condition is not due to an injury or other external cause.
